info.title: Neon self-hosted application Auth protocol
info.description: Curated allowlisted Better Auth 1.7.7 branch protocol. Separate from Console identity/control API. Conditional routes require operator mail and branch policy. The schema documents protocols; it does not assert a runtime is enabled or healthy. Optional self-hosted TOTP extension requires two_factor_enabled. Passwordless login paths retain their own policies; trusted-device cookies are not relayed. Optional admin_enabled exposes maintained administrator routes with current application admin authorization, persisted bans, and one-hour impersonation; Console sessions never authorize application administration. Optional organization_enabled adds current application membership roles, bounded quotas, verified-email invitations and active organization claims on newly issued JWTs. Existing JWTs retain their five-minute expiry; teams and dynamic roles are not enabled. Approved per-branch OAuth, SMS login and seven signed events are optional. No shared commercial OAuth credentials are bundled. Phone-first signup and provider token management are excluded. Blocking delivery rejects failures; native nonblocking events are queued atomically, claimed with leases and delivered on activity or explicit administrator drain. New issuer generations discard pending old deliveries/challenges. Event inspection requires a current application administrator.

applicationSession.name: neon_app_br_0123456789abcdef.session_token
applicationSession.description: HttpOnly branch cookie, established by native login. Schema query branch_id customizes this literal name; browser sends cookies, do not paste them into public evidence.

applicationFactorChallenge.name: neon_app_br_0123456789abcdef.two_factor
applicationFactorChallenge.description: HttpOnly 300-second pending branch MFA challenge; not an authenticated session. branch_id customizes the literal cookie name.

applicationAdminReturn.name: neon_app_br_0123456789abcdef.admin_session
applicationAdminReturn.description: Signed HttpOnly original administrator session reference, only during impersonation. Never a Console cookie.
